owner_decision: 2026-10-29: voice goes under the tenant LLM policy, egress log and PII protection (owner answered 'yes, to 1')

findings.issue: Production VoiceAgent() had no key and silently returned a canned transcript ('Apply sick leave for tomorrow due to fever') that /v1/voice/turn ran through the real agent as the employee's request.
findings.resolution: Missing key -> 503 VOICE_NOT_CONFIGURED; canned mode is opt-in (offline_mock=True) for tests only. Commit 2a43c98.

decisions_by_architect_under_delegation.decision: Per-tenant opt-in: llm_policy.voice_providers (closed set: sarvam), empty by default; otherwise 403 VOICE_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_TENANT before anything is sent.
decisions_by_architect_under_delegation.reason: Speech providers are data processors like LLM providers; fail closed, same place a DPO already reviews.

decisions_by_architect_under_delegation.decision: Every real Sarvam call is written to the existing egress log before it leaves (provider sarvam, model, sha256 of the payload, COMPLETED/FAILED); nothing is logged when nothing is sent.
decisions_by_architect_under_delegation.reason: One audit trail for all outbound personal data, visible on /v1/governance/llm-egress.

decisions_by_architect_under_delegation.decision: Text-to-speech never sends detectable PII: /synthesize answers 422 PII_EGRESS_BLOCKED; /turn returns the text reply with reply_audio_base64=null and audio_withheld=PII_EGRESS_BLOCKED.
decisions_by_architect_under_delegation.reason: Spoken text cannot carry redaction tokens; the employee still gets the answer on screen.

decisions_by_architect_under_delegation.decision: Speech-to-text audio cannot be redacted, so tenant opt-in is the only gate; the transcript is redacted by the LLM layer as usual.
decisions_by_architect_under_delegation.reason: Known residual risk; recorded so the DPA review covers raw audio.

decisions_by_architect_under_delegation.decision: Key from SARVAM_API_KEY; empty or absent -> voice stays 503.
decisions_by_architect_under_delegation.reason: No key means no silent fallback (VOICE-1).

residual: NEEDS_HUMAN: owner/legal - DPA with Sarvam before any real tenant lists voice_providers: [sarvam] (raw audio leaves under V4).
PII detection on spoken replies is pattern-based (email, phone, PAN, Aadhaar, ...); names are not detected without NER (already parked: NER/Presidio).
